milestones.title: Black Lives Matter protests
milestones.detail: George Floyd’s murder and the protests that followed changed the volume and focus of policing coverage in the UK.

milestones.title: Sarah Everard and Wayne Couzens
milestones.detail: Separate markers are needed for the disappearance, the policing of the Clapham Common vigil, the guilty plea and sentencing.

milestones.title: CSEW interruption
milestones.detail: Comparable annual perception estimates are missing during the pandemic. The chart must show the gap rather than interpolate it.

milestones.title: Elon Musk agrees and completes purchase of Twitter
milestones.detail: Record the agreement and completion separately when testing changes in the social-media environment.

milestones.title: David Carrick and the Casey Review
milestones.detail: A criminal case and an institutional review are distinct events and should not be collapsed into one marker.

milestones.title: Southport attack and subsequent disorder
milestones.detail: Track the attack, misinformation and disorder as separate linked events across England and Northern Ireland.
